how_it_works: Clear Normal, Elite and Boss levels on each Depth map, then claim the level rewards to open the next Depth. | Kill the Elite directly to chain-clear every Normal level after it; kill the Boss directly to chain-clear the whole Depth. | Kill all enemies within the turn limit to trigger a Chain and clear related levels at once; tap the map chest to claim them. | After Auto-Battle unlocks, spend Chain Licenses (1 per battle; they reset to 10 daily at 05:00). | Tap the Idle Farming chest before it hits its cap. | Open Fragment Chests as they finish; higher Depth gives better chests (UR chests start above Depth 60). | Multi-team stages: don't spread your strong units across all teams. Each team = 1–2 carries that solo the stage, 2–3 buffers that may die early, and a back-up whose passive says "Effective also in back-up state" (battle-start buffs persist; "while on the field" auras die with the unit).

Walk the map, fight enemies and open Treasure Caskets for points. | Watch HP: characters in an Exploration team don't recover lost HP after battles. | Finish the main goal quests to finalize the map and get its rewards. | At 20% Exploration Progress, use Sweep Coupons to collect all Map Rewards instantly.

Read the boss's characteristics, then set a team that answers them. | Strike the boss's weak points during the fight for extra rewards. | Invite other players to fight together if you can't solo it. | Only spend attempts you can win: Conquest Coupons are deducted only on victory, and a failed start costs just 1 Stamina. | For Formidable bosses (no Stamina cost), clear them in order; server-wide clear counts unlock bonus rewards.

Pick your team first: it's locked for the whole run. | Fight 3 stages in a row; HP carries over between them. | Expect enemies to gain random passive skills. | Clear as many stages as you can: more stages mean better Finalization Rewards. | Don't fear failing: a loss costs only 1 Stamina.

Pick the day's buff effects; they can't be changed after you confirm. | Clear stages in order; every owned character can take part. | Rotate units: lost HP is not restored, and no healing goes above a unit's pre-fight HP. | Respawns (revive one unit to 100%) only come with a Monthly Login Contract. | Come back daily: it resets every day. Spend tokens in the Blockade Breakthrough Shop. | Use your VIP manual reset attempts (VIP levels unlock them) to replay stages for a second round of rewards.

Dispatch eligible characters to Bounty Assignments and wait out the timer. | Fight the battle-type Bounty and Boss Assignments directly. | Meet the bonus goals for extra rewards; they don't block completion. | After 5-7 Bounty Assignments, an Urgent Assignment (co-op boss) may trigger; the first successful run pays Conquest Rewards. | Ask friends or strangers to help on Urgent Assignments after your first try. | Around the 9th-16th Bounty, an Assignment Sale can appear : buy only the Gold-priced items and skip the Diamond-priced ones.

Choose 1 character to bring in. Units below full stars are treated as full stars, so bring your best kit, not your highest star. | Move 1 grid at a time; you can't go back after a grid's event. | After each normal-map win, pick 1 buff (re-roll with simulation coins). | Beat each normal map's final boss to advance; after 3 normal maps, 3 hard maps open (no buffs there). | Don't quit mid-battle: losing or exiting fails the run. | Collect Abyss Coins from moves, battles, bosses and chests.

Stages unlock in order. The higher the stage, the harder it is and the better the rewards. | Save a line-up to enter: those characters are locked in, and lost HP carries over from fight to fight until the stage is cleared or the whole team is dead. | On the map, tap enemy groups to add them to one fight. Each group adds CP; enemies after the 4th wait in back-up and step in. | Defeat every boss and reach 100% Extermination to clear the stage. | If your whole team dies, the run fails. Give Up resets the area. | Your first clear is rated by how many battles you entered, and a better rating pays a better first-clear reward. | Every enemy gets Fixed Modifiers (they swap each week) and Regional Modifiers (by stage number). | Weekly reset: Monday 05:00 (server time). Clear at least 1 stage that week for the weekly reward. Next week you can start up to stage 9 if you cleared more than 7, stage 7 for 6–7, stage 4 for 3–5, stage 2 for 0–2. | When the Carnival ends, your highest stage pays the Carnival reward and sets where you start next Carnival.

Pick the right trial: STR/SKL/SPD trials only take that type (PSY, WIT and DST go anywhere); faction trials only take that faction. | Clear main stages in order; some unlock EX stages. | Check each stage's special rules before fighting. | On hard Elite stages, open other players' clear teams in the stage details and copy them.

Saturday after Takeover: preparation 15:30, battle 16:00–17:00 (server time). | Set your line-ups and study the map during preparation. | Each battle uses 1 team. Each stronghold has a required CP: a team below it can't attack. | Defeat defenders for Annihilation Points. When a stronghold's defenders are all beaten, it pays out by each Organization's rank there. | Lost HP is not restored right away. Fallen characters come back after a wait (1,200 s in the game settings), or revive at once with Diamonds or Quick Recovery Potions.

Attack daily: you get 3 attempts a day, and every challenge pays a reward. | Aim for damage milestones; single-battle and accumulated damage both pay. | Remember the boss can't be killed; it leaves after a while and the top 100 get ranking rewards.

Team up with a partner; each of you deploys one squad. | Win both battles to clear a floor (if your progress matches, either player can run both). | Wait for the floor's chests to unlock in sequence. | Clear a floor fully (boss + all chests) for a permanent stat buff.

Form a 3-player team (locked until Monday 05:00). | Fight 3 times with 3 different lineups; a unit used in one lineup can't join another that round. | Win for chests and points; your lineups can be attacked by other teams and lose you points.

Check each stage's required characters and level them first. | Pick the stage order you like. | Meet the 3 star conditions in one attempt; your best single attempt counts. | Fail freely: a loss costs only 1 energy.

Saturday: preparation from 10:00, battle 12:00–15:00, rank rewards at 15:00 (server time). | Each player sets 3 teams. You start from your Base, which can't be attacked, and can only attack tiles next to ones you hold. | You start with 10 attack charges and get 1 more every 20 minutes. You can buy 19 more for 2,790 Diamonds in total; the first 3 cost 50 each. | Every stronghold you hold earns points every 5 minutes. Strongholds still yours at the end pay a final share. | Taking another Organization's stronghold steals 50% of the points stored there. | Lost HP stays lost between fights and comes back slowly outside battle. Fallen characters recover slowly, or you revive them with Diamonds or Quick Recovery Potions (each revive costs more). | Healing can't raise a unit above the HP it had when the fight started.

Carnival Recruitment: the featured unit drops at 1% per pull, and every 100 pulls opens a chest whose contents change by season. Season 1 (Set Sail, likely this server's Carnival 1): 30% the featured unit, 30% a Selection Chest that offers only Kaneki [Christmas], Hinami [Christmas] or a Lv.6 Potential, 24% a Panacean Star-Up Crystal, 16% a Refinement Crystal. Season 2's chest has no Selection Chest (24% featured). Read the chest odds on each Carnival's banner, and pull only in blocks of 100. | Carnival Arena: 3 teams, best of 3, 10 tries a day (its own guide below). | Region Breakthrough: stage-by-stage fights with a locked team (its own guide below). | Carnival Exchange: spend Carnival Tokens. Tokens are not cleared when a Carnival ends. | Paragon Teams: Carnival Tokens raise a team's Paragon Level, a level boost in Carnival modes (its own guide below). | Stronghold Takeover and Stronghold Annihilation: the Saturday Organization wars (their own guides below). | Weekly Carnival quests pay about 2,000 Tokens and 1,050 Diamonds.

Save 3 line-ups; a line-up saves with at least 1 character. | Challenge a higher-ranked player; win and you swap ranks. | 10 tries a day, refilled at 05:00. Challenges close 1 hour before the 22:00 settlement. | Daily rewards at 22:00, weekly rewards on Sunday at 22:00 (server time). | Win at least 1 battle to get a rank. Rankings are cleared when the Carnival ends.

A Paragon Team holds several teams. Only max-level characters can join. | Carnival Tokens raise each team's Paragon Level; its members fight as if leveled above the level cap. | Max Paragon Level unlocks a Team Passive. Reroll it with Carnival Tokens for a better one. | The buff works only in Carnival modes, and all Paragon records reset when the Carnival ends.

You get 5 free challenges a day, refilled at 05:00 (server time). Extra challenges cost Diamonds, and each one costs more. | Beat a higher-ranked player and you take their rank. Lose to a lower-ranked player and you drop to theirs. | Daily rewards arrive by mail at 21:00 (server time), by rank. Reaching a rank for the first time pays a one-time reward. | Active Rewards: five chests a day for playing Arena battles; two of them pay 50 and 100 Diamonds.

You fight live players from every server. A win gains Points, a loss loses Points. | Every challenge uses a try, win or lose. Tries come back 1 per hour up to the cap. You can buy up to 10 Challenge Tickets a day with Diamonds; each costs more, and the price resets daily. | Your rank comes from your Points. Ranks reset on Monday from Sunday's final standing. | Daily reward: by your last rank of the day, after the challenge hours end. Season reward: by your tier, after the season ends. First time at each rank: a one-time reward that a reset does not take back.
